csv_scope_of_work: The Paris Junior College (PJC) is soliciting a Request for Qualifications (RFQ) for Architecture, Interior Design, and Engineering Services. Paris Junior College (PJC) is a public community college located in Paris, Texas, serving Lamar, Red River, Hunt, Hopkins, Delta, and Fannin Counties. The College is seeking statements of qualifications from experienced, licensed firms to provide comprehensive architectural, interior design, and engineering services in support of the College's facilities program.
